concepts.gloss_en: that the seed of Amalek be consumed/destroyed (finite piel verb כלה); glossed as 'yadber amim tachteinu' in Torah 6

members.note: representative; verbal head כלה (consume), distinct root and form from כרת

concepts.gloss_en: the cutting-off/extermination of the seed of Amalek (verbal noun); in Torah 35 identified with sparks rising from among the nations, per the 11 incense spices

members.note: representative; nominal head (כריתות), Torah 35 context distinct from the infinitive form in Torah 6

concepts.gloss_en: to cut off the seed of Amalek (infinitive of purpose); in Torah 6 identified with Yehoshua, the lower point

members.note: representative; infinitive verbal head, shares root כרת with כריתות but different form and Torah context (6 vs 35)

notes: All three name the eradication of Amalek's seed but differ in verbal head (כלה vs כרת), morphological form (finite verb / verbal noun / infinitive), and Torah context (6 vs 35), each mapped to a different bechinah. Per rules 3 and 4 these are kept as separate concepts; a human may choose to relate them as an eradication-of-Amalek theme without merging identities.
